purpose: Bind the machine-readable construction/material registry to the actual Unity Material assets used by the benchmark before any formal native-4K evidence frame is rendered. For Standard materials whose BRDF is texture-driven, validate the effective source-channel metallic and roughness ranges instead of treating control scalars as final material values. This is source/runtime preflight only and awards no Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: For active Standard _MetallicGlossMap materials, metallic is evaluated from the source red-channel range and roughness from one minus the selected source alpha-channel range multiplied by _GlossMapScale. This prevents the control scale from being misidentified as the final roughness.

Source-channel inspection is fail-closed to PNG/JPG/JPEG texture assets and is cached by dependency hash plus file size/time. Unsupported or runtime-only mapped textures must gain an explicit, reviewable inspection path before formal evidence is allowed.
Source texture extrema do not prove the final filtered, compressed, mipmapped or anisotropic BRDF response; sealed native-4K grazing-light pixels remain authoritative.
A passing registry binding cannot clear impossible_material_physics or baked_or_painted_highlights without direct review of the canonical native-4K grazing crops.
This guard intentionally rejects a registered material asset that is no longer bound by any active benchmark renderer; stale metadata must be updated rather than silently accepted.
